info.title: Maven Java JDBC MySQL connection setup

diffs.patch:
Index: pom.xml
===================================================================
--- pom.xml	
+++ pom.xml	
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+
+  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
+  <artifactId>mysql-jdbc-demo</artifactId>
+  <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
+  <packaging>jar</packaging>
+
+  <name>mysql-jdbc-demo</name>
+  <description>Sample Maven project that queries a MySQL database via JDBC</description>
+
+  <properties>
+    <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
+    <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
+    <mysql.connector.version>26.7.0</mysql.connector.version>
+    <exec.mainClass>com.example.db.App</exec.mainClass>
+  </properties>
+
+  <dependencies>
+    <dependency>
+      <groupId>com.mysql</groupId>
+      <artifactId>mysql-connector-j</artifactId>
+      <version>${mysql.connector.version}</version>
+      <scope>runtime</scope>
+    </dependency>
+  </dependencies>
+
+  <build>
+    <plugins>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+        <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
+        <version>3.16.0</version>
+      </plugin>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+        <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+        <version>3.6.4</version>
+        <configuration>
+          <mainClass>${exec.mainClass}</mainClass>
+        </configuration>
+      </plugin>
+    </plugins>
+  </build>
+</project>

Index: src/main/resources/db.properties
===================================================================
--- src/main/resources/db.properties	
+++ src/main/resources/db.properties	
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+db.host=localhost
+db.port=3306
+db.name=testdb
+db.user=root
+db.password=changeme
+db.query=SELECT 1 AS ok

Also env var override: App loads db.properties then System.getenv(), so env vars with keys db.host etc. won't work directly because env var names typically uppercase. Actually putAll(System.getenv()) would override with env vars like "db.host"? Env vars can't have dots typically. So that override is mostly ineffective. Hmm. Maybe better to support DB_HOST etc. But keeping simple. Actually the config loads db.properties then overlays environment - but env var keys would be like PATH etc, not db.host, so it just adds unrelated vars. It's harmless but the claim of override is weak. Let me improve to read specific env vars with mapping so it's actually useful. Or remove env overlay. Simpler: remove it to avoid misleading. But allowing env override of password is good practice (don't commit secrets). Let me implement targeted env overrides DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_QUERY.
